blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **два → двух** — genitive, prepositional and accusative, with an animate noun. In oblique cases the numbers always agree in case with the noun to which they refer.
exercises.prompt: Genitive, prepositional and accusative, with an animate noun
